title: anthosachne multiflora subsp. kingiana
intro: Anthosachne multiflora subsp. kingiana, commonly known as King's Wallaby Grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is reported to have various health benefits, including antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of infections and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential remedy for skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of King's Wallaby Grass include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
